response.text:
I can’t open the report right now — you said no PDF/web tools are available and I don’t have any pages attached in this chat. Because I must inspect the actual PDF pages before I can give page-level citations for emissions targets, I can’t do that until you provide the file or the relevant pages.

What I need from you (pick one):
- Upload the full annual report PDF in this chat, or  
- Upload images or a PDF of the specific pages you want examined, or  
- Paste the text of the report pages that include the emissions targets.

When you supply the file/pages I will:
- Identify every explicit emissions target (GHG targets, baseline year, target year, scope1/2/3 coverage, interim targets, % reductions, net-zero pledges, etc.)
- Give a precise page-level citation for each (e.g., "Page 42 — ‘We will reduce Scope 1 and 2 emissions 50% vs. 2019 by 2030’")
- Provide short context for each target (metric, baseline, timelines, assurances such as verification or targets aligned to SBTi)
- Quote or excerpt the exact wording from the page (if you want quoted text)

Before you upload, quick questions to make the extraction precise:
- Do you want only formal targets (committed reduction/ net-zero pledges), or also aspirational statements and long-term goals?
- Should I extract targets for Scope 1/2 only, or include Scope 3 commitments too?

Upload the PDF or pages and I’ll extract the targets with page citations. If you already uploaded a file and it didn’t attach, please try again and tell me the filename.
